**Root Cause: Service selector no longer matches pod labels after Helm chart migration**

When cart-service was moved to the new platform Helm chart template in v4.2, the pod labels changed from the legacy `app: cart-service` label to the Kubernetes recommended labels (`app.kubernetes.io/name`, `app.kubernetes.io/instance`, `app.kubernetes.io/version`). The Service selector was not updated to match, so it selects zero pods and the Service has no endpoints — causing the "cart unavailable" error for all users.

**Evidence observed:**
- Both `cart-service` pods (`cart-service-6d5f8c7b9-4hnwq` and `cart-service-6d5f8c7b9-kq7rd`) are Running and Ready, but their labels are:
  - `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`
  - `app.kubernetes.io/instance: cart-service`
  - `app.kubernetes.io/version: 4.2.0`
  - `pod-template-hash: 6d5f8c7b9`
  — **there is no `app: cart-service` label on either pod.**
- The Service selector is still `app: cart-service`, which matches none of the above labels, so the control plane builds an empty EndpointSlice and kube-proxy routes zero traffic to the pods. [cite: tasks/debug/debug-application/debug-service#does-the-service-have-any-endpointslices-2] [cite: concepts/services-networking/endpoint-slices#endpointslice-resource-0]

**Fix (choose one):**

**Option A – Update the Service selector** to match the new labels the pods already carry:
```yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service
```
Apply with: `kubectl patch svc cart-service -n shop --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/selector","value":{"app.kubernetes.io/name":"cart-service"}}]'`

**Option B – Add the legacy label back to the pod template** in the Helm chart values so the existing Service selector continues to work:
```yaml
podLabels:
  app: cart-service
```
Then redeploy cart-service with the updated values.

Either option will make the Service selector match the pods, causing the control plane to automatically populate the EndpointSlice and restore traffic. [cite: concepts/services-networking/endpoint-slices#endpointslice-resource-0] [cite: tasks/access-application-cluster/connecting-frontend-backend#creating-the-hello-service-object-0]
